ui.you_can_search_multiple_maps_at_once_: You can search multiple maps at once using a comma separator ','
ui.hide_normal_map_labels.tooltip: Hide labels and extra markers on ordinary maps. Keep special encounters, unique/tagged maps, selected categories and search/route targets. Native nodes and route connections stay visible.
ui.draw_connected_node_and_badge_counts_: Draw connected-node and badge counts under each map label on the Atlas.
ui.draw_the_node_s_content_under_each_ma: Draw the node's content under each map label, using the known names.
ui.also_show_unmapped_content_as_its_raw: Also show unmapped content as its raw 0x value (for identifying new content).
ui.highlights_the_atlas_nodes_and_connec: Highlights the atlas nodes and connections revealed by the hovered Uncharted Waters ship.
ui.marks_uncharted_waters_ships_that_the: Marks Uncharted Waters ships that the game is not currently rendering.
ui.predicts_the_deterministic_rite_modif: Predicts the deterministic Rite modifiers for eligible Ritual-line routes.
ui.lists_and_highlights_ritual_routes_an: Lists and highlights Ritual routes and their predicted rewards while line mode is active.
ui.maximum_path_length_in_maps_to_clear: Maximum path length in maps to clear.
ui.node_text_color_the_path_automaticall: Node-text color. The path automatically uses the more colorful of the text and background colors.
ui.node_background_color_the_path_automa: Node background color. The path automatically uses the more colorful of the text and background colors.
atlas.ritual_weights_hint: Planner routes are sorted by the sum of these weights over the route's predicted rewards, highest first. 0 = neutral; negative pushes a route down the list.
atlas.planner_filter_hint: filter by desired rewards (any match shows the path)…
plugin.description: Atlas map labels, search, route highlighting and Ritual reward display.
